thread:
Rae (Finance): Heads-up: MedWay Partners (EMEA reseller) requested an exception for a 5-month pilot: 25% introductory usage credit applied to partner-billed volume + Net60 invoicing. They also want VAT passthrough and invoice in EUR. Need deal-desk sign-off and CFO approval.

Ben (Sales): Context: pilot to win a multi-hospital roll-out in IE/UK, estimated 200k tokens/mo ramping to 500k. Partner says this concession is required to cover integration and compliance costs.

Isha (RevOps): Operational constraints: cap total credits to EUR 20k; restrict credits to the partner master account and mapped end-customer IDs; clawback if any mapped end-customer terminates within 90 days. We need a Zuora ticket for a custom "intro_credit" line and a holdback rule.

Tom (Legal): Draft addendum suggested. Need clear definitions: "introductory usage credit" = percentage applied to gross usage charges on Redwood invoice to partner; expiration date; clawback formula; reps on VAT and audit rights. Will add a short indemnity clause for misreported volumes.

Celia (CFO): Net60 impacts DSO. I will consider conditional approval if (1) 50% of credits are held as AR holdback until month 3, (2) partner passes a basic credit check, and (3) trade refs on file. Also confirm FX exposure if invoicing in EUR.

Rae (Finance): Accounting note: treat the credit as contra-revenue and amortize monthly over the pilot. Isha please confirm Zuora can implement holdback + cap.

Isha (RevOps): Can do. I'll open ZOA-10221 to create `intro_credit` charge type, set recognition rule to monthly amortization, and implement a 50% holdback until month 3. Linking to deal MDW-304.

Ben (Sales): MedWay provided VAT ID and two trade references. I'll route the addendum for signature today. ETA 48h for signed docs.

billing-bot: Created ticket ZOA-10221 linked to MDW-304.

Tom (Legal): Addendum draft uploaded to deal MDW-304. Includes 25% credit up to EUR20k, pilot 2026-10-01 to 2027-02-28, prorated clawback within 90 days, and VAT representation.

Celia (CFO): Conditional approval: proceed once signed addendum, ZOA-10221 live with 50% holdback, and trade refs/credit check complete. If any item fails revert to Net30.

Rae (Finance): Approve in principle. Final sign-off will be posted here once RevOps and Legal confirm execution. Keep all follow-ups in thread.

Ben (Sales): Thanks everyone 64f. I'll post signature confirmation and docs when complete.
